description: What this project needs to load Draco, KTX2 (Basis) and meshopt glTF files, wired with the decoder files of the INSTALLED three (examples/jsm/libs), so they match the loaders: which models need which decoder (extensionsUsed/Required), how the code points each loader at its files (three's folder, a local folder, a CDN), whether the served files hash-match the installed three, and a CDN transcoder of another three release. write: true copies the files into the served folder (public/ with a bundler, else next to the page), adds the missing setup after `new GLTFLoader()` (setDRACOLoader / setKTX2Loader with detectSupport / setMeshoptDecoder, imports in the file's own style; drei: useGLTF.setDecoderPath) and pins CDN paths, as one undoable step. Default: a dry run.

framework.description: vanilla GLTFLoader or React Three Fiber (drei useGLTF); default auto

model.description: only this .glb/.gltf (default: every model in the project)

path.description: Project folder, or a file or folder in it (relative to the server's folder; default: the project).

public_dir.description: the folder served at / (default: public/ when there is one or a bundler, else the page's folder)

three.description: Path to a three package folder, when it is not in node_modules above the project.

write.description: copy the files and patch the code as one undoable step; default false shows what it would do

name: three_decoders
title: Wire up Draco, KTX2 and meshopt decoders
